entities.summary: Evan Vucci is an American photojournalist, currently serving as a senior photojournalist for Reuters in Washington, D.C. Vucci shoots and produces both still photography and video projects worldwide, as well as on various subjects including Washington, D.C.–based sports, the U.S. military, and U.S. politics.
